the number of unique users is the most important factor in the use of shared print collections, and that the number of users who use shared print collections in any given year is a function of the number of unique visitors to the libraries in that year.

it has been a success in terms of our ability to provide access to print and digital resources. But we are still struggling with how to make our print and digital collections work together.

the library community needs to be more proactive in its approach to shared print.
